correctness.rationale: For \(h∈\{3,4\}\) and \(n\ge3\), the \(T_h\) closed-walk bijection is exact because every 3-column local neighborhood obeys the same B3/S23 rule; repeated columns at length three are distinct lattice sites and counted correctly. An explicit 256-state \(T_4\) has exactly one cyclic SCC, its 127-state adjacency B is primitive by strong connectivity and empty-column self-loop. Exact symbolic determinant, independent SCC check and Collatz-Wielandt positive integer vector \(B^{400}\mathbf 1\) bound the Perron root between 2.55371542 and 2.55371544. Every \(F_4(n)\) is \(\operatorname{tr}(B^n)\); trace <=127 \(\lambda^n\). Height-three independently constructed \(T_3\) has a 27-state SCC with exact charpoly \(x^{24}(x^3-27)\), hence contributes \(3^{n+1}\) when \(3\mid n\); all other fixed state contributions are nonnegative. The exact inequality \(127\cdot13^{27}<3\cdot15^{27}\) handles all \(n\ge27\), and exact transfer counts handle \(n=3,6,\ldots,24\). A separate direct 2^(4n) exhaustive B3/S23 checker confirms n=3..6. No finite empirical extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The fixed-configuration population is a canonical combinatorial-dynamical invariant of Life. Row thickening increases configuration space but provably reduces all fixed configurations at every naturally selected triple circumference. The selection arises from a genuine height-three cubic spectral resonance, while a primitive height-four Perron component grows strictly below base three. The exact 127-state transfer and rigorous eigenvalue bound give an all-circumference asymptotic, not a tiny arbitrary table or trivial substitution. It links structural spectral shifts to a sharp cross-width count reversal. Limits: no assertion for nonmultiples or oscillators, and the isolated prior \(4\times4\) count is credited.
